I've been a customer here for years and have had my good and my bad experiences with this store. For instance, this store seems to be busy and packed nonstop. I've gotten here early in the morning and later in the day and no matter what, always busy. I attribute that to the fact that this is the only Apple Store in Delaware and we are tax-free. Overall, a very modern store. I remember what it used to look like and post-renovation, it looks great. The staff is as knowledgeable as possible. That being said, there are some employees there (the last time I was there) that can be seen walking around not pulling as much weight as the other employees in the store. That might be a management problem or it might just be the employees are having an off day.

The store could be a lot better though in several ways. I wouldn't allow the store to get so packed that you can only stand around when needing service for your device. At least a line outside the store or something or an outside sitting area for customers who have a long wait. Because those waiting for service are using up as much space on the sales floor as possible and that entire part of the store is not separate from anything else. It's just at the farthest end of the store.

One last thing: if we are waiting for however long, at least have some music over the speakers or something to create some ambiance instead of having to hear customers and employees discuss a potential purchase.

If i would compare this panera store to the one on Kirkwood hwy.
Christiana Mall Panera Bread: All of the Staff are friendly and eager to help customer and co workers. They don't use those annoying little buzzer, they actually call your name on the ticket. A lot more seating as well as outdoor seating (though too cold for January). Also they have multiple outlets for you to charge your computer and other devices, and a lot of options to your seating. In other words, you can sit just about anywhere, and have access to an outlet.  The food was great as usual, but i wasn't thrilled how my apple looked, but I'm picky about apples.
Kirkwood hwy Panera: the newly renovated, a lot of open space when you first come in. Not as much seating, and only two outlet near the fireplace. Which leads me to believe this location is more of a resturant. They use buzzer, which is unnecessary...but whatever rocks your boat.
